# FERS Retirement Calculator

> A free, browser-based educational estimator for federal employees. It explains FERS pension rules and estimates retirement income without requiring an account.

## What this page does

The page checks your retirement eligibility, calculates the basic FERS annuity and supports advanced inputs for unused sick leave, military buyback, special category multipliers, survivor benefits, and the FERS Special Retirement Supplement. It also shows a replacement rate and compares retirement age scenarios.

## Important limitation

This is an independent educational estimate. It is not an official OPM benefit determination. Federal employees should verify their numbers with HR and OPM.
